title: Where should adaptation begin?
description: Vary harm and labeled evidence, then authorize a response. The release boundary changes as operational certainty changes.

actions.label: Observe and collect labels
actions.detail: Keep the incumbent while improving evidence and slice coverage.

actions.label: Repair the data source
actions.detail: Restore the feature contract before changing model behavior.

actions.label: Contain or roll back
actions.detail: Reduce exposure while the cause or labels remain uncertain.

actions.label: Recalibrate the policy
actions.detail: Adjust thresholds or calibration without relearning ranking.

actions.label: Train and canary a candidate
actions.detail: Update the model using representative, trusted labels.
actions.changes: Training data, model artifact, and release

cases.label: Broken telemetry unit
cases.context: One feature violates its unit contract after an upstream release.
cases.guardrail: Do not admit malformed records into a training window.
cases.validation: The repaired source restores valid ranges and expected predictions on replayed traffic.

cases.label: Holiday prevalence change
cases.context: Confirmed positives increased, but ranking and within-class score shapes remain stable.
cases.guardrail: Preserve ranking and test calibration on the current prevalence.
cases.validation: The new threshold improves decision cost without degrading protected slices.

cases.label: Changed approval policy
cases.context: Labeled evidence shows that similar inputs now produce different outcomes after a policy change.
cases.guardrail: Keep the incumbent available until the candidate passes current and historical slices.
cases.validation: A canary restores calibration for the affected slice without historical regressions.

cases.label: Unlabeled safety spike
cases.context: User reports indicate severe harm, but reliable outcome labels are still sparse.
cases.guardrail: Reduce exposure before waiting for enough labels to diagnose the model.
cases.validation: The fallback lowers reported harm while the investigation collects trustworthy evidence.

cases.label: Expected seasonal mix
cases.context: Inputs moved in a known seasonal window, with no confirmed outcome degradation.
cases.guardrail: Do not spend model risk budget on an unproven failure.
cases.validation: Labels and product metrics stay within seasonal bounds as the window matures.
